hypotheses.basis: Strict universal interpretation: every passenger must share the same flights and cabin with every other passenger in the reservation. Violation occurs whenever the all-same condition fails.
unresolved_terms: scope of 'flights' (entire itinerary vs. any single flight segment)

hypotheses.basis: Existential pairwise interpretation: each passenger must share flights and cabin with at least one other passenger in the reservation, but not necessarily all passengers with each other. This is strictly weaker than universal sharing. The atom 'all_passengers_same_flight_and_cabin' being false does not necessarily indicate violation under this reading.
unresolved_terms: whether 'share' requires pairwise-existential or universal quantification over the set
whether the atom set can express existential pairwise sharing without also implying universal

hypotheses.basis: Vacuous compliance boundary: a reservation with exactly one passenger trivially satisfies the sharing requirement because there is no other passenger to differ from. This reading treats single-passenger reservations as automatically compliant regardless of the state atom.
unresolved_terms: whether 'share' is vacuously true for a singleton set
